'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[2022–2023 bombing of Kherson]]
****[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] attack [[Kherson]], injuring 23 [[civilian]]s and damaging infrastructure. [https://kyivindependent.com/update-23-injured-in-russian-attack-against-kherson-oblast/ (''The Kyiv Independent'')]
**A peace mission visit of African officials to Ukraine is interrupted by a Russian missile attack according to the [[Ukrainian Air Force]], which says it has shot down six [[Kh-47M2 Kinzhal|Kinzhal]] [[ballistic missile]]s, six [[Kalibr (missile family)|Kalibr]] missiles, and two [[reconnaissance]] [[Unmanned aerial vehicle|UAVs]]. [https://news.yahoo.com/news/african-leaders-set-meet-presidents-082455161.html (AFP via Yahoo! News)]
*[[Allied Democratic Forces insurgency]]
**[[Mpondwe school massacre]]
***Forty-one people are killed, including 38 students, eight others injured and at least six [[kidnap]]ped during an attack by five [[Allied Democratic Forces]] [[jihadist]]s at a [[secondary school]] in [[Mpondwe]], [[Western Region, Uganda|Western Region]], [[Uganda]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/6/17/dozens-killed-in-attack-on-ugandan-school-near-drc-border (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir]]
**Five foreign [[militant]]s are killed in a [[gunfight]] with police in [[Kupwara district]], [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Jammu and Kashmir]], [[India]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/indian-police-say-five-foreign-militants-killed-kashmir-2023-06-16/ (Reuters)]
*[[Mali War]]
**[[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Mali)|Foreign Minister]] [[Abdoulaye Diop]] requests the [[United Nations Security Council]] to terminate [[United Nations Multidimensional Integrated Stabilization Mission in Mali|its peacekeeping mission]] in [[Mali|the country]] immediately, citing its "failure" to help improve the situation. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/6/16/mali-asks-un-to-withdraw-its-peacekeeping-mission-without-delay (Al Jazeera)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*The [[Music of the United States|United States]]-based [[The Recording Academy|Recording Academy]], organizer of the annual [[Grammy Awards]], announces that songs incorporating [[artificial intelligence]] (AI) may be considered for awards, provided there is a significant human creative contribution. However, songs purely generated by AI are ineligible for awards, and only human creators are eligible. [https://time.com/6288131/grammys-ai-rules/ (''Time'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*More than 80 people are injured in a [[multiple-vehicle collision]] involving three [[school bus]]es in [[Hongcheon County]], [[Gangwon Province, South Korea|Gangwon Province]], [[South Korea]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/over-80-hurt-south-korea-school-bus-crash-fire-official-2023-06-16/ (Reuters)]
*A magnitude 4.8 [[List of earthquakes in France|earthquake]] strikes [[Niort]], [[Deux-Sèvres]], [[Nouvelle-Aquitaine]], [[France]], injuring two people and severely damaging hundreds of buildings. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-65940654 (BBC News)]
*The village of [[Brienz/Brinzauls]] in [[Grisons]], [[Switzerland]], is narrowly missed by an overnight {{convert|2|e6m3|e6ft3|abbr=unit}} rockslide. The village of 128 residents had been [[emergency evacuation|evacuated]] in May after scientists predicted the imminent rockslide. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-65926381 (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Pittsburgh synagogue shooting]]
**The gunman in the 2018 [[Tree of Life – Or L'Simcha Congregation|Pittsburgh synagogue]] shooting in [[Pennsylvania]], the deadliest [[antisemitic]] attack in [[U.S. history]], is found guilty on 63 [[criminal charge|charges]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/amp/US/pittsburgh-synagogue-mass-shooting-verdict-reached-federal-death/story?id=100104078 (ABC News)]
*[[Japan]] raises the [[ages of consent in Asia|age of consent]] from 13 to 16 and criminalises [[voyeurism]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/jun/16/japan-raises-age-of-consent-from-13-to-16-in-reform-of-sex-crimes-law (AFP via ''The Guardian'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[2023 in archosaur paleontology]]
**A study in ''[[Science Advances]]'' reveals that [[Chilean Antarctic Institute]] scientists have discovered [[fossil]]s from an unprecedented [[herbivorous]] [[hadrosaur]] called ''[[Gonkoken nanoi]]'', which inhabited [[Patagonia]] 72 million years ago. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/duck-billed-dinosaur-gonkoken-nanoi-fossil-patagonia-chile-3568211 (CNA)]
